content: PostgreSQL catalog "char" columns (relkind, polcmd, tgenabled, prokind, provolatile, typtype, attidentity, attgenerated) cannot be concatenated to a string literal: `'kind=' || relkind` fails with `operator is not unique: unknown || "char"` because "char" has an IMPLICIT cast to text (pg_cast castcontext='i'), so both text||anynonarray and anynonarray||text match. Booleans/bigints are fine (no implicit cast). Fix: `relkind::text`. Measured 2026-09-11 on supabase/postgres:17.6.1.166 while writing ops/supabase-restore/fingerprint.sql. concat_ws(... "char" ...) as a direct argument is fine.

Running Testcontainers against lelabo-ubuntu (lelabo@100.76.160.91) Docker, measured 2026-09-11: (1) Tailscale SSH there is in check mode; if the Tailscale login is stale every new SSH session prints a login.tailscale.com check URL and times out unapproved (~minutes) - Daniel fixed it by re-logging into Tailscale. (2) Tailscale SSH REFUSES unix-socket forwarding: `ssh -L sock:/var/run/docker.sock` -> `administratively prohibited: socket path "/var/run/docker.sock" is not in an allowed directory`. Exec sessions work, so `docker --context lelabo-ubuntu` (ssh dial-stdio) works. (3) Testcontainers 12.1.0 treats DOCKER_HOST=ssh:// as a TCP host, so it needs a local unix socket bridge that runs `ssh host docker system dial-stdio` per connection, plus TESTCONTAINERS_RYUK_DISABLED=true. (4) macOS unix socket paths max 104 bytes and OpenSSH appends a 17-char suffix to ControlPath: `${TMPDIR}bl-%C` is too long (every mux connection stalls with `unix_listener: ... too long`); `${TMPDIR%/}/bl-%h` works (master 0.9s, dial-stdio ping 0.25s). Bridge helper lived in session scratchpad only, not committed.
